stem: Which detail from paragraph 13 of the article “Acoustic Sculpture, Sound Art, and the Music of the Sea” best supports the key idea that the Wave Organ is a work of art?
instruction: Use “Acoustic Sculpture, Sound Art, and the Music of the Sea” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Richards listened to Fontana’s recording before he built the Wave Organ.

options.label: B
options.text: The Wave Organ was constructed with pipes.

options.label: C
options.text: Richards built the Wave Organ on San Francisco Bay.

options.label: D
options.text: The Wave Organ was deliberately designed to create an interesting effect.
